title: An Initial Investigation of an Alternative Model to Study Rat Primordial Germ Cell Epigenetic Reprogramming
author: Cantão, Tesser, et al.
materials: After 5 days in culture, the gonads were removed from the membrane dissociated in collagenase/dispase solution (10,269,638,001, Roche) at 37 °C, for 20 min. The cell suspension was incubated for 2 h in 12-well plates pre-treated with gelatin (G1890, Sigma) for somatic cell adhesion. The medium containing non-adhered cells (including PGC) was centrifuged and resuspended in 1X PBS (pH 7.2) containing magnetic beads pre-incubated with biotinilated Dolichus biflorus agglutinin (DBA). The suspension was incubated for 1 h at 4 °C rocking and placed in a magnetic rack (Invitrogen). The positive selected cells (PGC) and the negative selected cells (somatic cells) were submitted to RNA isolation using TRIzol® (Invitrogen). The cells that adhered to the 12-well plates in the first step of the selection were treated with 1X trypsin (59418C, Sigma) and combined with the magnetic negative selection cells for RNA isolation. The cDNA was obtained using the Superscript III Reverse Transcriptase (Invitrogen). Conventional PCR was performed using specific primers for the developmental genes Pax6 (FP 5′-agtgaatgggcggagttatg-3′ and RP 5′-aacaaccacatgagccaaca-3′) and Dazl (FP 5′-gaaatggcccacaaaagaaa-3′ and 5′-ttaagcactgcccgacttct −3′).

steps.title: Prepare animal housing and anesthesia
steps.instruction: Keep adult Wistar rats in plastic cages on a 12‑h light/12‑h dark cycle at 23–25 °C with food and water ad libitum; anesthetize dams with xylazine 10 mg kg⁻¹ and ketamine 100 mg kg⁻¹, then euthanize by cardiac incision.

steps.title: Collect and sex embryos
steps.instruction: Harvest embryos at 14, 15, 16 and 19 days post‑coitum (dpc); at 15, 16 and 19 dpc determine sex by morphological inspection of gonads and retain only male gonads.

steps.title: Fix gonads for histology
steps.instruction: Fix gonads from 14, 15 and 19 dpc embryos either in Bouin’s solution for 6 h or in Carnoy’s solution for 48 h, then process for paraffin embedding and cut 6 µm‑thick sections.

steps.title: Dissect 16 dpc gonads and incubate with 5‑Aza‑CdR
steps.instruction: Dissect male gonads from 16 dpc embryos (20 embryos from 6 mothers) and incubate them with 5‑Aza‑2′‑deoxicytidine (5‑Aza‑CdR) as described in the culture step; all procedures follow CEUA protocol Nr. 7,001,040,914.

steps.title: Culture gonads in 24‑well plates
steps.instruction: Place dissected gonads into 24‑well plates that already contain a 45 µm pore membrane and culture medium with or without 5‑Aza‑CdR; keep the culture for 5 days, changing the medium daily. After culture, either fix the gonads or proceed to RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Add gonads to wells with 45 µm membrane and appropriate medium.
Incubate for 5 days, replacing the medium each day.
At the end of culture, choose fixation or RNA extraction.

steps.title: Dissociate cultured gonads with collagenase/dispase
steps.instruction: Remove gonads from the membrane and dissociate them in collagenase/dispase solution (Roche, catalog 10,269,638,001) at 37 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Adhere somatic cells on gelatin‑coated plates
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to 12‑well plates pre‑treated with gelatin (Sigma, G1890) and incubate for 2 h at room temperature to allow somatic cells to adhere.

steps.title: Magnetic selection of PGCs with DBA beads
steps.instruction: Collect the non‑adherent cells (containing PGCs), centrifuge, and resuspend the pellet in 1X PBS (pH 7.2) containing magnetic beads pre‑incubated with biotinylated Dolichus biflorus agglutinin (DBA); incubate 1 h at 4 °C with rocking, then place the tube on a magnetic rack (Invitrogen) to separate DBA‑positive PGCs from negative somatic cells.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge non‑adherent cells and resuspend in 1X PBS (pH 7.2) with DBA‑coated magnetic beads.
Apply magnetic rack to collect DBA‑positive (PGC) fraction; keep the negative fraction.

steps.title: Detach remaining somatic cells with trypsin
steps.instruction: Treat the cells that remained adherent in the gelatin‑coated plates with 1X trypsin (Sigma, 59418C) to detach them, then combine this trypsin‑released population with the magnetic negative‑selection cells for downstream RNA isolation.

steps.title: Isolate RNA from cell fractions
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from both the DBA‑positive PGC fraction and the combined somatic fraction using TRIzol® (Invitrogen) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA from RNA
steps.instruction: Reverse‑transcribe the isolated RNA into cDNA using Superscript III Reverse Transcriptase (Invitrogen) following the supplied instructions.

steps.title: Amplify Pax6 and Dazl by PCR
steps.instruction: Perform conventional PCR on the cDNA using the following primers: Pax6 forward 5′‑agtgaatgggcggagttatg‑3′, reverse 5′‑aacaaccacatgagccaaca‑3′; Dazl forward 5′‑gaaatggcccacaaaagaaa‑3′, reverse 5′‑ttaagcactgcccgacttct‑3′.
